subject: guncon2: Improve support for clones/compatible devices (#121)
author: Phil Eichinger
provenance_doc_ref: Not a provenance-doc row: new fork work (PR #121), parent 9fcb1cb21.

impact.effect_if_absent: guncon2_usb_irq() ignores every report whose length is not exactly 6, so a GunCon 2 clone that sends 7-byte reports enumerates but never moves the cursor or reports a button. Nothing in dmesg.
affected_hardware: Thrustmaster Beretta 92FS (sold as GunCon 2 compatible; 7-byte reports)
other GunCon 2 clones that enumerate as 0b9a:016a with longer reports

forward_port.conflicts: The fork commit's own hunk does not apply to our series: 0010 creates hid-guncon2.c in kernel style (tabs, /* */ comments), not the fork's 4-space layout, so the one-line change is folded into 0010's new-file hunk.
forward_port.effort: trivial -- one comparison operator. Each full series applied in order at patch -p1 -F0 to pristine tarballs, hash-checked against the pins: de10nano 59/59 on linux-6.18.64, linux-rt 58/58 on linux-7.3.5, de25nano 39/39 on linux-7.4-rc4. Zero fuzz, zero offsets. drivers/hid/hid-guncon2.o builds W=1 with 0 warnings on all three (arm, arm, arm64).

license_provenance: GPL-2.0 (the file's SPDX tag). Author Phil Eichinger, who opened PR #121. The commit carries no Signed-off-by. 0010 credits it in its Provenance block and does not add a sign-off on the author's behalf.
notes:
NOT IN MAINLINE: no drivers/hid/hid-guncon2.c in linux-7.4-rc4, so there is nothing upstream to compare.

SAFETY OF '>= 6'. The URB buffer is devm_kmalloc(usb_endpoint_maxp(epirq)), so a longer report fits the buffer, and the handler reads only data[0..5]. Byte 7 is ignored, its meaning on the Beretta is unknown. A genuine GunCon 2 still sends 6 bytes and behaves as before. Reports shorter than 6 are still dropped.

All three boards take it: 0010 is a symlink in board/mister/de10nano/patches/linux-rt/ and board/mister/de25nano/linux-patches/, so one edit reaches the 6.18 image, the 7.3 beta/RT series and the DE25.

NOT TESTED on hardware: no Beretta 92FS or GunCon 2 here.
